summary: TechCreate Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a CEO letter to shareholders regarding NYSE American delisting proceedings. The NYSE American Listing Qualifications Panel decided to delist the company on August 20, 2026, following an SEC trading suspension. The company has requested a review by the NYSE American Committee for Review and intends to appeal. No wrongdoing by the company was found. Shares now trade on OTC under TCGLF. The outcome is uncertain, as delisting is at the exchange's discretion. Watch for the Committee's review decision and potential relisting efforts.
